newsitem.title: SPAIN: Police safely destroy car bomb in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Police safely destroy car bomb in Spain.

text.p: Spanish police said on Tuesday they safely destroyed a bomb planted in a prison worker's car in the southern city of Granada.
The prison worker, identified only as the father of two young children, alerted police who then carried out a controlled explosion.

Officials did not say whether Basque separatist rebels ETA were responsible, but the group has targeted prison staff over the past year and the device was made of materials ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has used in its drive for independence.
ETA, which has held a prison worker hostage for more than 500 days, claimed responsibility for killing a prison psychologist on March 11.
